claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_bonus_action_attack
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Bonus Unarmed Strike grants the ability to make a specific attack type (Unarmed Strike) as a Bonus Action. grant_extra_action grants a full Action, not a Bonus Action slot for a specific attack; no existing atom captures 'bonus action unarmed strike' as a passive passive grant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: replace_damage_die
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Martial Arts Die replaces the base damage die of Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons with a class-level-scaled die (d6→d8→d10→d12). natural_weapons is close but only applies to Unarmed Strike (not Monk weapons), carries no scaling (uses a bare number not DiceAmount), and changes damage type — all three properties are wrong here. A 'replace_damage_die' atom scoped to a weapon filter with DiceAmount scaling would cover this.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can roll 1d6 in place of the normal damage of your Unarmed Strike or Monk weapons. This die changes as you gain Monk levels.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: substitute_ability_for_rolls
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Dexterous Attacks lets the monk use DEX instead of STR for attack and damage rolls of Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons. modify_roll_numeric adds a fixed delta; no existing atom expresses 'use ability A in place of ability B for these rolls'. Also needed for the Grapple/Shove save DC substitution.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier for the attack and damage rolls of your Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons. In addition, when you use the Grapple or Shove option of your Unarmed Strike, you can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier to determine the save DC.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.not_wielding_shield
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature's entire gate requires 'not wielding a Shield' as a condition alongside 'not wearing armor'. The existing not_wearing_armor predicate covers the armor half, but there is no not_wielding_shield variant in EquipmentPredicate.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: ...while you are unarmed or wielding only Monk weapons and you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.unarmed_or_monk_weapons_only
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature gate requires 'unarmed OR wielding only Monk weapons' (Simple Melee + Light Martial Melee). The wielding_weapon predicate has coarse weapon-kind categories (ranged/melee_two_handed/melee_one_handed/two_weapons) with no way to express 'unarmed' or 'Monk weapon category (Simple or Light Martial Melee)'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: ...while you are unarmed or wielding only Monk weapons and you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield.
